verdict.rationale: Postmark documents official client libraries across TypeScript, Python, Rails/Ruby, .NET, Java, and PHP, backed by extensive API endpoint documentation and TypeScript-specific code examples (auth, batch sending, templates, webhooks, idempotency). Community evidence also confirms real developers integrating quickly via these SDKs/API. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of SDK quality/maintenance across all listed languages beyond TypeScript, and no public OpenAPI spec found by probe.
